answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before trading, sized to its transaction volume. New identities begin on a narrow trust terrace with tiny limits that widen only after verified, completed work. Reputation grows like a vine, branching through attestations from counterparties who risk their own stake when vouching. The fable of cheap fake identities fails here: each Sybil must fund its own stake, and fraud triggers slashing that burns it. One honest agent keeps one stake and compounds trust; a thousand fakes must pay a thousand times.
